what: Trigger-C pre-postbump refresh lacks bash best-effort contract
scenario_or_breakage: Bash `run_bump_phase` runs `refresh-run-logs.sh` with `|| true` (scripts/ship-pr.sh:1119-1121) and always continues to postbump; current `finalize.postbump` stalls on many `flush_logs_pre` skips, and the plan moves refresh to `ship.py` without stating non-fatal behavior — a fail-closed skip could block bump where bash proceeds.
suggested_fix: Call `flush_logs_pre` (or equivalent) before `finalize.postbump`, log/ignore skips and commit failures, and never stall the bump phase on refresh outcome; add a `test_ship.py` case that refresh failure still reaches postbump with `log_write_status=skipped`.
